evidence: Modifies block and undo file storage in src/node/blockstorage.cpp (+194/-30) to handle on-disk block file obfuscation and crash-safe migration.
rationale: Allows operators of nodes synced prior to Bitcoin Core v28 to obfuscate existing block and undo files without redownloading the entire chain. Antivirus scanners can trigger false-positive deletions on unobfuscated block files, making resumable in-place migration a clear user-facing improvement, but it is reasonably deferrable as newer nodes already default to obfuscation.
